title: rulean check report
description: The JSON report of `rulean check --report FILE` (spec 09.4). Fields are only added. A change of the meaning of a field changes the schema version.

build.description: verified only for a build whose proofs passed (spec 13.4).

format.description: The input format and the format version, such as ndjson-3.1.0. The value is ndjson if the meta line was not read.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes that were checked.

lean_version.description: The lean.version field of the meta line, or an empty string.

profile.description: The semantics profile (spec 05.2), or null if no profile was selected.

error.description: The reason for a verdict that is not accept.

failed_decl.description: The name of the declaration that stopped the check.

quarantine.description: The number of unsafe and partial constants (spec 05.10).

deviations.description: The rows of docs/deviations.json that changed this run.

quarantine.description: The names of the unsafe and partial constants.

pin_mismatch.description: The primitives whose declaration is not the reference declaration (spec 05.8).

engine.description: The engine of the definitional equality queries and the counts of engine F (spec 05.1).

f_queries.description: The queries that engine F tried.

f_equal.description: The queries where engine F found an equality.

f_fallback.description: The queries where engine F did not find an equality, so engine R decided them.

f_faults.description: The queries where engine F stopped with a fault, so engine R decided them.

r_confirmed.description: The equalities of engine F that engine R confirmed.

r_disagree.description: The equalities of engine F that engine R did not confirm.

session.description: The session: the cached judgments on frozen closed terms that stay across declarations (spec 08.4).

entries.description: The entries in the session at the end of the run.

hits.description: The lookups that found a valid entry.

stores.description: The entries that went into the session.

drops.description: The entries that were not kept, because the promotion budget was used.

evictions.description: The entries that the CLOCK policy removed.

promoted.description: The scratch nodes that were copied into the frozen tier.
